name: Servall Uniform & Linen Supply
old_description: A professional appearance is the groundwork for your reputation. It affects your staff every day, from attitude and team spirit to quality of work. At Servall Uniform & Linen Supply, we are dedicated to making sure your business looks its best while upholding comfort and safety at the same time. Because we’re not only serving you, we’re serving the community that relies on you. When clean cannot be compromised, count on your partners at Servall Uniform & Linen Supply for dependable linen rentals and uniform services.
about:
Servall Uniform & Linen Supply was founded in 1938 in Rapid City, South Dakota. From its start serving hometown businesses, the company has grown to operate across a two-state region, with physical locations in Chamberlain, South Dakota, and Gillette, Wyoming (and an office in Cheyenne, Wyoming). The business remains privately held, though ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides uniform rental and direct purchase, linen rental, industrial laundry services, restroom and sanitation supplies, janitorial products, first aid kits, dust control mats, towel and bedding programs, hand sanitizer stations, and ice melt. Servall manages scheduled pickup and delivery for its rental programs, serving hundreds of customers throughout western South Dakota and eastern Wyoming from its regional facilities.

Customers include healthcare providers such as Spearfish Canyon Healthcare, hospitality landmarks like Wall Drug, publishing operations such as Ravellette Publications, financial institutions including First Interstate Bank, and independent retailers like Alternative Fuel Coffee House. The company’s service area covers communities from Spearfish, Custer, and Hot Springs in South Dakota to Sheridan, Gillette, and Buffalo in Wyoming.

Servall emphasizes reliable, locally based service and the convenience of consolidated facility supply programs. Its stated mission is to provide dedicated, professional service that delivers cost value and enhanced productivity within weeks, backed by long-tenured delivery representatives who build ongoing relationships with client sites.
